Kristján was very keen for us to be comfortable. He welcomed us personally and showed us what was on the property. In addition, he did a little extra for our family when we were in Iceland for a family celebration.
We appreciated that it was a large room, where we could cook, sit and plan together, and play games.
The property is on a farm, and if you are aware of that, then it's great.
We thought it was a good location for doing things in the area.
In addition, there were two cautious but very cuddly cats walking around in the yard.
